lines.en: label library30:
scene nodokafirst1
I walk into the library first thing in the morning to be greeted by a rather unusual sight.
And by unusual I mean a sight I have literally never seen before.
Typically, Futaba will spend her mornings rearranging books or...picking up books, or...
Well, you get the point.
There are a lot of books involved.
It’s not often she actually engages with anyone other than me.
Is this girl planning on stealing Futaba away from me?
: Who are you and what do you want with my librarian?
: Your librarian? Futaba didn’t tell me the two of you were in that sort of relationship.
: Sincerest apologies for what I am about to tell you, but this librarian has been my property for several years now.
: I’m willing to share her as long as you go through the proper request process. There are several caveats, however.
scene nodokafirst2
: No touching, no teasing, no flirting, no talking, no exchanging of gifts (Including those sexual in nature), no staring and, most importantly-
scene nodokafirst3
: No-doka.
: I have no idea what that last one even means.
: It’s my name. Nodoka Nagasawa, a friend of Futaba’s from another[school].
: I’ve seen her exposed breasts more times than you.
I wouldn’t be so sure about that...
scene nodokafirst4
: Nodoka was in town on a...business trip, I guess?
: She decided to stop by before heading back to the outer-barrier.
: Business trip? How old are you?
: Old enough. You need not concern yourself in my private ordeals.
: You’re not some sort of prostitute, are you?
: Not that I am aware of.
: Are you the type to hire those sorts of people? If so, would you mind if I asked you some questions?
: It’s for research, I swear.
: Right. Research.
: No, it really is for research, Sensei.
: Nodoka is a writer and tends to dive into rather...unsightly topics at times.
: My favorite is [incest]. It’s truly fascinating in fictional settings. Wouldn’t you agree?
: Futaba is literally in the same class as my [niece]. I’m not going to share my opinion of [incest] with you. Fictional or not.
scene nodokafirst5
: Your lack of a response is the only response I need! Thank you very much!
What a strange character...
: Anyway, were you planning on hanging out with your friend today, Futaba?
: If so, I can just leave you two to it and go figure something else out.
scene nodokafirst4
: No need. I need to be heading out anyway.
: I just wanted to drop by and see if Futaba’s grown anymore since the last time I saw her several weeks ago.
: She refused to take her shirt off in the library, though, so I don’t think I’ll be getting an answer today.
scene nodokafirst6
: You never change, do you?
: Why would I? I’m perfect the way I am. Just like you’re perfect the way you are.
: Well, thanks Nodoka. I’m glad to hear-
: Let’s get married.
: Damn it. You’ll agree to that one day.
: I really won’t...
scene nodokafirst7
: You there. Glasses-companion. Let me know if you can figure out Futaba's latest cup-size.
: Is that for research as well?
: No. It’s for my own personal records.
: I see. That’s good enough for me. I’ll have Futaba send you a message once I find out.
: Why are you agreeing to this? And why do I have to be the one to send the message?
: Because I don’t give my number to strangers.
scene nodokafirst8
: But anyway, thanks for letting me visit for a little bit.
: This library is much smaller than the one I’m used to, but it’s cute. It’s got a sort of...rustic charm to it.
: Maybe I’ll come back one day?
scene nodokafirst9
: Sayonara, Futaba! And you as well, mystery-man!
: My name is Sensei.
: No it isn’t!
Nodoka exits the library and leaves Futaba and I sitting there in silence for a little while.
: So anyway, that’s Nodoka.
: She seems...fun.
: She’s a lot.
scene nodokafirst10
: She’s one of the smartest people I know, though. You should read some of her work if you ever get the chance.
: Where would I find it? Is she online or something?
: I can...umm...maybe send you a few links?
: Do you have my number? Or email address or anything?
scene nodokafirst11
: Well, no...But if you wanted to maybe...give it to me or something...that would be okay.
: That’s not too weird to say, right?
: I promise I’d only text you if I need something or...have to give you something.
: You can text me whenever you want. I don’t care.
scene nodokafirst12
: Really?! You mean it?!
scene nodokafirst13
: Oh! Umm. Sorry. I didn’t expect to react that way.
: I don’t know what came over me.
: It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
I take my phone and slide it across the table, giving Futaba the go-ahead to enter her contact info.
She nervously does so and, before long, both of our phones are back in our respective pockets.
$ futabanumber = True
Congratulations! You now have Futaba’s phone number!
: So, now that your friend is gone and the two of us are alone, there’s been something I’ve been meaning to ask you.
scene nodokafirst14
: Umm...it’s nothing...you know...sexual, is it?
: I’ve accepted that we have that type of relationship now but I still don’t know if I’m comfortable...you know, helping you out in the library.
: There are people around and-
: I was actually just going to ask if everything was okay.
scene nodokafirst15
: Huh?
: What do you mean?
: I mean that we haven’t really talked about what randomly sent you home from the beach.
: Molly was pretty upset that you weren’t able to play that game with everyone, and that seemed like something you’d be really into.
scene nodokafirst16
: On second thought, maybe I could...give you a handjob...under the table or something...
: As much as I love under-the-table handjobs, it sounds to me like you’re trying to hide something.
scene nodokafirst17
: That doesn’t sound very confident, Futaba.
: Why would you even want to know that? I look fine now, don’t I?
I hadn’t noticed before, but now that I’m paying closer attention, Futaba does look a little bit...off.
I can’t really pinpoint exactly what’s wrong, but something’s different.
And no, I’m not talking about her hair being down. It’s something more than that.
: I want to know because I care about you.
scene nodokafirst18
: S-Sensei...You can’t just come out and say that all of a sudden...it’s embarrassing.
: There are people around. Someone might hear you.
: What’s so bad about people hearing that I care for one of my students? I care about all of you.
: It’s just...someone might get the wrong idea.
: Well that’s on them, then. But don’t worry about other people right now.
: If something is bugging you, it’s okay to tell me.
scene nodokafirst19
: Th-thanks...but I’m pretty sure I’d rather keep this thing to myself if that’s okay.
: It’s not like...a really big deal or anything. It would only create more problems for you.
scene nodokafirst20
: But I’ll be better for it in the long run. Just worry about yourself and let me deal with my issues on my own.
: ...It’s not about Yumi, is it?
: It’s not. She actually hasn’t even said anything to me since the beach.
Huh...if Yumi’s not the source of her problems this time, I wonder what is?
I know her family lives overseas so...maybe it’s something that has to do with them?
Either way, it doesn’t look like she’s willing to reveal whatever’s going on right now, so I should probably just talk about something else.
: So, Nodoka.
scene nodokafirst21
: Yes, Nodoka.
: She’s cute, isn’t she?
: If there’s anything I’ve learned about girls that I’m involved with it’s to never talk about how cute other girls are around them.
: I don’t see a problem with you thinking she’s cute. I think she’s cute and I’m not planning on leaving you for her.
: Though, I think she'd be quite happy if I did.
: If you do decide to do that, please let me know in advance so I can buy a video camera.
scene nodokafirst22
: Please stay out of my first lesbian relationship. You and I are no longer together.
: What we had was fun, but it was as fleeting as a summer breeze.
: You were just an old tooth that happened to be pushed out by a new one.
: That first metaphor was a little stronger than the tooth one.
scene nodokafirst23
: We can’t all be Nodokas, you know? I’m doing my best.
: That’s right. You are doing your best. And that’s really all that matters.
scene nodokafirst15
: Hm? Why are you getting serious all of a sudden?
: I didn’t mean to. It just kind of slipped out, I guess.
: Maybe I’m subconsciously worried about you since you’re keeping your first ever secret from me.
scene nodokafirst10
: Who said this is the first?
: Either way, I think you should subconsciously stop because it’s harder for me to smile when you’re not smiling.
: And yes, I know that line probably needed some work as well.
: It was better than the tooth one at least. That one still hits me the wrong way for some reason.
: Yes, yes. I know it was bad. I won’t talk about teeth anymore.
: I appreciate that.
I pull my phone out of my pocket and check the time to find that it’s getting close to lunch.
Since the two of us don’t seem to have anything else going on, maybe Futaba will want to come out for a little bit?
No harm in asking, I guess.
: Hey, are you doing anything after this?
scene nodokafirst15
: Like, after the library? Not really. Why?
: Did you want to come get lunch or something? I’m probably going to head out soon.
scene nodokafirst21
: That does sound fun, but I need to stay here for pretty much the entire day today.
: Thank you for inviting me, though. It makes me happy to hear that...you want to spend more time with me and stuff...
: You have to spend the whole day here? Aren’t you a volunteer?
: I am, but that doesn’t mean I can just leave whenever I want.
scene nodokafirst24
: I have a responsibility and I can’t walk away from it. That’s what it means to be an adult.
: But of course you wouldn’t know that since you’ve given up on teaching and just want to hang out with everybody instead.
: Don’t question my methods. Your grades are better than ever.
scene nodokafirst25
: Grades? We have grades?
: I thought we were just messing around.
: We were, but I’m giving you an F now for losing faith in my patented system.
scene nodokafirst13
: An F?! You can’t do that! I thought we were just joking!
scene black
Little does Futaba know, I’m the most serious man in the world.
I never joke about anything.
Just kidding.
But either way, I’m significantly less willing to spend my entire day wasting away in a library than Futaba is.
Who cares about responsibility when there are more important, more fulfilling things to be doing?
I offer to buy Futaba something and bring it over in order to make her double-volunteer-shift a bit more bearable, but she shrugs off my act of generosity and tells me she brought something with her.
What a bitch.
Just kidding again.
Not knowing what else to do, I stop at a nearby burger joint and grab a quick lunch before getting on with my day...
$ library30 = True
$ futaba_love += 1
Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
jump saturdayafternoon
